editorial: When the stars become your only confidant, you feel the ship's hum echo your marriage's growing silence. Spaceman lets a mysterious creature become your mirror, turning every lonely corridor into a room for self reflection. Joaquin Phoenix carries every scene with almost no dialogue, turning his eyes into the film’s quiet voice. If you crave a psychological space drama that holds you in quiet suspense, this is the experience for you, though the middle third drifts a bit longer than it needs to.
targetAudience: Ideal for viewers who crave psychological depth in thinly plotted space dramas.
watchReasons: Joaquin Phoenix delivers a quiet, solitary performance
The creature's uncanny silence offers a surreal twist
